AVISHEK BASU PRODUCT OWNER | PAYMENT ENGINE MIGRATION | SWIFT | CBPR+ | SEPA | CIPS | AGILE SAFE PRACTITIONER

Results-driven Payments Product Owner with experience in leading end-to-end payment transformation programs across global financial institutions. Targeting senior leadership opportunities in Product Ownership, Product Management, or Business Analysis across diverse industries.

basuavishek7@gmail.com

+917824065333

PROFILE SUMMARY

❖ Payments Product Owner with over 9 years of experience delivering large-scale payment transformation, ISO 20022 migration, and cross-border

payment modernization programs for global banks and financial institutions.

❖ Expertise in end-to-end payment lifecycle management, including initiation, validation, clearing, settlement, reconciliation, and exception handling

across SWIFT, SEPA, CIPS, and CBPR+ frameworks.

❖ Proven track record in product backlog ownership, user story creation, acceptance criteria definition, and functional specification design, ensuring

seamless translation of business needs into technical deliverables.

❖ Experienced in leading payment engine migration programs (legacy to modern API-based platforms), including gap analysis, system mapping, and

stakeholder alignment across multi-geography teams.

❖ Skilled at Agile/Scrum/SAFe delivery environments, facilitating sprint ceremonies, managing cross-functional teams, and driving prioritization

decisions in high-pressure, regulated banking ecosystems.

❖ Strong stakeholder leader with expertise in conflict resolution, trade-off analysis, and business requirement sign-off, ensuring delivery alignment

between product, operations, technology, and client stakeholders.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Payments Product Ownership

ISO 20022 Migration (pacs / camt / pain)

Cross-Border Payments Transformation

SWIFT MT/MX Messaging Standards

CIPS & RMB Payment Processing

SEPA Credit & Direct Debit Schemes

Payment Engine Modernization & Migration

Agile Product Management (Scrum / SAFe)

Payment Lifecycle Management

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

User Story & Acceptance Criteria Definition

Functional & Non-Functional Requirement Analysis

SOFT SKILLS

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Growth-oriented Leadership

Cross-functional Team Collaboration

Adapatabiltiy in Critical Environment

❖ API Integration & Management ❖ SQL ❖ JIRA ❖ Confluence ❖ Azure Boards ❖ ServiceNow

Analytical & Critical Thinking

CERTIFICATIONS

Strategic Planning & Execution

❖ Digital & Data Foundation — Artificial Intelligence — KPMG, 2025 ❖ Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) — Scrum Alliance, 2024 ❖ Certified SAFe® 6 Practitioner — Scaled Agile, 2023

CAREER TIMELINE

May’16 – Apr’19

Oct’20 – Sept’22

Sept’22 – Feb’25

Feb’25 – Present

Business Analyst | Accenture

Senior Business Analyst – Payments Consultant | Accenture

Product Definition Analyst (Product Owner) | Amadeus IT Group

Senior Consultant – Payments Product Owner | KPMG

WORK EXPERIENCE

Feb’25 – Present

Senior Consultant – Payments Product Owner | KPMG Assurance and Consulting Services LLP | Remote Client: Standard Chartered Bank China — SWIFT/CIPS to SCPAY Payment Engine Migration Key Result Areas:

❖ Defined and prioritized the product backlog based on stakeholder feedback, business value, and strategic goals. ❖ Facilitated structured stakeholder engagement through product walkthroughs, sprint ceremonies, and requirement

review sessions across China business, operations, and global technology teams.

❖ Produced application-to-application interface specifications and data mapping documents defining integrations

between SCPAY, upstream channels, and downstream finance and reporting systems.

❖ Supported UAT cycles and production go-live readiness through test validation coordination, defect triaging, and

resolution tracking with QA and engineering teams.

❖ Translated business requirement documents into detailed software requirement specifications and ensured

alignment through structured walkthroughs and formal sign-off cycles.

❖ Delivered knowledge transfer and onboarding sessions for 30+ team members, enabling continuity across delivery

workstreams and functional understanding.

❖ Acted as primary point of contact for product clarifications, requirement decisions, and stakeholder alignment across

multiple global and regional teams.

❖ Coordinated Agile delivery ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives,

ensuring delivery governance and continuous improvement practices.

❖ Defined and refined user stories with detailed acceptance criteria, ensuring clarity of requirements and alignment

between business stakeholders and engineering teams.

Highlights: ❖ Spearheaded end-to-end product backlog governance for migration of China payment flows (SWIFT MT, cross-border

RMB via CIPS) to SCPAY API-based payment engine, including user story definition & acceptance criteria.

❖ Performed comprehensive current-state assessment of legacy payment processing platform and executed gap

analysis against target SCPAY architecture across functional, regulatory, and operational dimensions.

❖ Defined migration scope, delivery sequencing, and impacted system landscape, including timeline planning and end-

to-end data and message mapping in coordination with delivery leadership and SMEs.

❖ Covered full payment lifecycle analysis including initiation, validation, clearing, settlement, exception handling, and

reconciliation processes across systems.

❖ Owned prioritization and continuous refinement of product backlog items based on business value, regulatory

requirements, stakeholder inputs, and strategic roadmap objectives.

Sept’22 – Feb’25

Product Definition Analyst (Product Owner) | Amadeus IT Group | Bengaluru Key Result Areas: ❖ Functioned as Product Owner for a payments reconciliation product covering retail payments sales and settlement

data, including backlog ownership & prioritization aligned to business value, stakeholder inputs & strategic objectives.

❖ Converted complex payments operations requirements into structured user stories with well-defined acceptance

criteria, enabling development teams to implement accurate and auditable reconciliation workflows.

❖ Acted as primary interface for product-related queries and clarifications, managing stakeholder expectations and

addressing conflicts through structured trade-off evaluation while maintaining delivery alignment.

❖ Coordinated Agile sprint ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives,

ensuring consistent delivery cadence and process adherence.

❖ Presented product demonstrations during sprint reviews to internal and external stakeholders, communicating

feature progress, completion status, and alignment with defined business requirements.

Oct’20 – Sept’22

Senior Business Analyst – Payments Consultant | Accenture Solutions Private Limited | Kolkata, India (Remote) Client: Fiserv Enterprise Payments Platform (EPP) — EMEA Global Banks (CBPR+, SEPA, TARGET2) Key Result Areas: ❖ Defined functional and non-functional requirements for Fiserv EPP implementations across EMEA banking clients,

covering CBPR+, SEPA (SCT/SDD/Instant), and TARGET2 payment schemes.

❖ Led ISO 20022 migration initiatives for multiple EMEA financial institutions, including gap analysis and preparation of

functional specifications for development and QA teams.

❖ Supported product backlog refinement activities in collaboration with Product Owners, including translation of

business requirements into user stories and contribution to prioritization and change request analysis.

❖ Facilitated requirements validation and sign-off sessions with client stakeholders, along with defect triaging, SME

coordination, and release support activities.

❖ Contributed to delivery of payment hub enhancements by collaborating with product, delivery, and client banking

teams, ensuring alignment across requirements, changes, and defect resolution cycles.

Santander Bank North America — SWIFT MT103 Wire Transfer Migration (PayPlus → Fiserv Dovetail) Key Result Areas: ❖ Executed migration of wire transfer processing from PayPlus to Fiserv Dovetail Payments Platform, covering inbound and outbound SWIFT MT103 messages & integration with channels, third-party systems & core banking applications. ❖ Performed interface mapping and end-to-end gap analysis between legacy and target systems, identifying functional

gaps and improvement opportunities across payment flows.

❖ Engaged in collaborative team discussions for knowledge sharing, requirement clarification, and structured problem-

solving to support delivery consistency.

❖ Developed and maintained project documentation supporting training and operational readiness, ensuring clear

understanding of new system processes and workflows.

❖ Conducted root cause analysis for processing issues, coordinated resolution activities, and facilitated knowledge

transfer sessions for 30+ team members to ensure smooth onboarding and continuity.

May’16 – Apr’19

Business Analyst | Accenture Solutions Private Limited | Pune, India Client: Barclays UKRBB — Retail Banking Channel Migration (Account Opening, KYC, Digital Debt Switcher) Key Result Areas: ❖ Contributed to migration from Barclays Customer Gateway System to a Multi-Channel Application platform, supporting business analysis across Create Customer, Account Opening, KYC, and Digital Debt Switcher modules. ❖ Elicited, documented, and structured business requirements in collaboration with stakeholders, ensuring clear

articulation of scope, risks, and dependencies, with timely escalation of issues impacting delivery alignment.

❖ Provided regular updates in Agile stand-ups to Scrum Master and Product Owner, covering requirement clarity,

analysis progress, and dependency tracking across workstreams.

❖ Coordinated deployment readiness activities with development and environment teams across multiple test

environments, enabling stable builds for functional validation and testing cycles.

❖ Converted business requirements into BDD-based test scenarios, enabling alignment between business expectations,

development implementation, and structured validation outcomes.

❖ Managed defect tracking and resolution in collaboration with development teams, validating fixes against business

requirements and supporting structured retesting cycles.

❖ Conducted functional walkthroughs and demonstrations across multiple applications, validating delivered features

against documented requirements and ensuring stakeholder alignment.

EDUCATION

M.B.A. in Marketing & Analytics, 2019 Great Lakes Institute of Management, Chennai

B.Tech., 2016 KIIT University, Bhubaneswar

PERSONAL DETAILS

Languages: English, Hindi, Bengali Address: Bangalore, India
